title: The (p,q)-Analogues of Bi-Stirling Eulerian Polynomials via continued fractions
summary: We establish Jacobi-type continued fraction expansions for (p,q)-analogues of the bi-Stirling Eulerian polynomials, which refine classical Eulerian statistics on permutations. These polynomials admit equivalent definitions in terms of descents or excedances. The parameters p and q encode refined permutation statistics, including (ldes,rasc) and (cros,nest). Our approach is based on weighted Motzkin path models arising from variants of the bijections of Françon--Viennot and Foata--Zeilberger.
